call_sequence: Exact original test loop: sub_range_metrics(point, point+100), first returned score array, then only the last score from each following call.
boundary_issue: Metrics._compute_indexes returns the last index below stop, but sub_range_metrics uses it as an exclusive slice endpoint: 100 requested samples become 99. Consequently the loop emits N-1 scores and never processes the final input point.
source_version_note: The Metrics module changed since the earlier offline run (Metric constructor was restored); the Metrics class methods and MADDetector formula are unchanged. This run uses current source snapshots and constructs Metric/Metrics exactly as in the test.
interpretation: A reference recomputed on each sliding fragment adapts to sustained dispersion; an offline reference over the entire record does not. Changing only window=10 to window=20 is a separate factor. The input Kafka raster reconstruction differs from the synthetic Gaussian series in the test image.
